name: Sootworks Diary
summary: Dwarven forge-city of pipework, blast furnaces, and rune-bound steel. The Soot King reigns from the deep vein. Bring a stout, your best pickaxe, and a tolerance for ash.

tasks.description: Enter the Sootworks from the Heartlands.
Mine coal in the Sootworks mines.
Smith a bronze bar at the Sootworks furnace.
Kill a mine spider.
Buy a dwarven stout from Vendor Grit.
Take the steam tram to the lower levels.
Talk to Forgemaster Brun.
Use the Sootworks anvil.
Mine 10 coal in one trip.
Kill 3 mine spiders.

easy.reward: Sootworks cape (easy) + emote: tip helmet. Diary lamp (easy).
easy.perk_description: Sootworks teleport (3/day); noted coal from rock golems.

tasks.description: Complete Sootworks Rising quest.
Use the Blast Forge (half-coal smelting).
Kill a rock golem with magic.
Smith a mithril platebody.
Mine mithril ore in the Sootworks.
Complete a lap of the Sootworks Pipe Network agility course.
Kill a clockwork sentry with ranged.
Collect 10 clockwork gears.
Smith a full set of soot-iron weapons.
Kill a crazed miner.

medium.reward: Sootworks cape (medium) + Blast Forge access (half coal). Diary lamp (medium).
medium.perk_description: Blast Forge half-coal smelting; +10% soot-iron yield from sootworks rocks; pipe network shortcut.

tasks.description: Complete The Forge Beneath the City quest.
Kill an iron dragon with magic.
Smith an adamant platebody.
Complete a full Sootworks Pipe Network lap without failing.
Kill a rogue automaton.
Mine adamantite ore in the deep mines.
Kill a lava beast without taking fire damage.
Smelt a runite bar at the Blast Forge.
Kill Vorath, Warden of the Deep Vein.
Collect 50 blast powder.

hard.reward: Sootworks cape (hard) + deep mine shortcut. Diary lamp (hard).
hard.perk_description: Deep mine shortcut; +5% smithing success; auto-smelt at the Blast Forge.

tasks.description: Defeat the Soot King in a group of 3+.
Kill a steel dragon.
Smith a rune platebody from bars you smelted.
Mine a volcanic core (mining 75).
Complete every Sootworks quest.
Kill a mithril dragon with magic only.
Complete the Dragon Slayer of Aelgard quest.
Kill 50 iron dragons.
Use the infernal pickaxe (auto-smelt) in the Sootworks.
Complete an elite clue step in the deep vein.

elite.reward: Sootworks cape (elite — molten-trim recolour), unlimited Sootworks teleport, smithing apprentice's brand. Diary lamp (elite).
elite.perk_description: Unlimited Sootworks teleport; auto-smelt unlocked at every Sootworks furnace; +5% chance of double bars at the Blast Forge.
